test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Fatima was __at her wits’ end__ trying to decide on a serene place for spending the holidays in.

options.text: So worried, confused or annoyed that she does not know what to do next
So worried, confused or annoyed that she became unconscious
So calm and composed that she knows what to do next
So worried, confused or annoyed that she insulted others for no reason

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"at her wits' end"** means being so worried, confused, or annoyed that one does not know what to do next. (इतना चिंतित, भ्रमित या परेशान होना कि अगले कदम का पता न हो।)

 
 
• **Example:** She was **at her wits' end** trying to manage the unruly children.
 
 
 
• **Worried** refers to feeling anxious or concerned about something. (चिंतित)
 
 
• **Example:** He was** worried **about his upcoming exams.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the idiom **'at her wits' end'** means being in a state of extreme worry or confusion.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** So worried, confused or annoyed that she became unconscious (इतना चिंतित, भ्रमित या परेशान होना कि वह बेहोश हो गई)

 
 
• **Example:** She was so stressed that she almost fainted.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** So calm and composed that she knows what to do next (इतनी शांत और संयमित कि उसे पता है कि आगे क्या करना है)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the chaos, she remained calm and composed.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** So worried, confused or annoyed that she insulted others for no reason (इतना चिंतित, भ्रमित या परेशान होना कि उसने बिना किसी कारण दूसरों का अपमान किया)
 
 
• **Example:** His frustration led him to snap at his colleagues.
 
 

15c:Tbd8,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
